$comment: Mission 1.67 §8. More names than were deeply evaluated. The universe is NOT exhaustive and does not claim to be.

excluded_classes: static indexes generated entirely from another scanner

frozen_controls.$comment: §5. These may not be rediscovered as new.

example_concepts_used: dated Internet scan snapshots SSH banner

exhaustiveness.statement: This mission ran a bounded search under a fixed document budget. That no qualifying apparatus was found does not establish that none exists.

hits.name: Rapid7 Project Sonar
hits.reason: Internet-wide active surveys stated first-party; first-party method documentation retrievable across four independent pages; product-relevant protocol coverage plausible.

hits.name: Shodan
hits.reason: Own crawler infrastructure and crawl algorithm stated first-party; help centre, book, API reference and filter reference all retrievable; product relevance plausible.

hits.name: BinaryEdge
hits.reason: Three separate paths on the first-party documentation host each 301-redirect to one non-technical customer notice on an acquirer's help centre, which itself returns HTTP 403. §10 forbids elevating a hit to serious on marketing or help-centre pages alone.

hits.name: ZoomEye
hits.reason: Three documented hosts attempted: one returned a page title only, one HTTP 521, one DNS timeout.

hits.name: Criminal IP
hits.reason: Both attempted first-party developer documentation paths returned HTTP 403. Not retried and no header varied.

hits.name: FOFA
hits.reason: Both attempted documentation paths returned a client-side navigation shell carrying section headings and no field documentation.

hits.name: Netlas
hits.reason: Frozen control under §5. May be referenced as a methodological control and may not be rediscovered as new.

hits.name: ONYPHE
hits.reason: Frozen control under §5. Its regional port-set heterogeneity is cited in this mission's requirement review as a methodological example, which §5 permits.

hits.name: LeakIX
hits.reason: Frozen control under §5.

hits.name: Shadowserver
hits.reason: Frozen control under §5.

hits.name: Censys
hits.reason: Already evaluated and dropped in Missions 1.58 and 1.59 on MERGED_CURRENT_STATE and SNAPSHOT_TIME_SEMANTICS_NOT_ALIGNABLE. §5 names four frozen controls and this is a fifth known-dropped apparatus, so it is recorded here rather than treated as a discovery.

hits.name: scans.io / Internet-Wide Scan Data Repository
hits.reason: Carried as a lead only. A project hypothesis that it is operated by an already-dropped apparatus was NOT established first-party this mission and must not be read as a classification.

hits.name: GreyNoise
hits.reason: Carried as a lead only. A project hypothesis that its collection is passive sensor-based rather than active probing was NOT established first-party this mission.

hits.name: RIPE Atlas
hits.reason: Carried as a lead only. Active distributed measurement exists; whether it performs internet-wide TCP service surveys carrying identification strings was NOT established first-party this mission.

hits.name: CAIDA Ark
